verdict.rationale: Kick documents an audit trail that logs every categorization, rule action, and AI decision (kick-supp-audit-trail, kick-docs-10), and rules/period locks provide some governance over automated logic (kick-docs-7, kick-docs-18, kick-supp-locks). However, there is no documented mechanism to version rules/automations, review pending automation changes before they apply, or roll back a specific automated action once executed. Missing for 10: rule/automation version history, explicit rollback/undo of an automation's effects, and a review-before-apply workflow for AI/rule changes.
